# Paw Pantry

Paw Pantry is a demo direct-to-consumer pet essentials store for dogs and cats.

## Customer flows
- Browse and filter products on the home page.
- Add products to a local shopping cart.
- Review quantities, apply demo code WELCOME10, and enter delivery details at /checkout.
- Place a cash-on-delivery demo order. No real order or payment is transmitted.

## Agent tools
When supported by the browser, the page registers `search_products` and `add_product_to_cart` through WebMCP. Visible controls remain the source of truth and work without WebMCP.
